title: Book Our Beautiful Sandy Shell Flat | Condo in Rosemary Beach FL – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: If you're looking for a stunning 2-bedroom apartment in a great neighborhood in Rosemary Beach, this is just the place for you! Click here and book our amazing Sandy Shell Flat now.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Make yourself at home in Sandy Shell Flat! This two bedroom, two bathroom unit is in a prime location across from a guest favorite, the Splash Pad and neighboring St. Augustine Green. First floor placement adds to the appeal.

Sandy Shell is the perfect spot to relax. Sit back in an Adirondack chair on the patio or meander through the community on the flat's two complimentary adult bikes. Enjoy family movie night on the spacious living room sectional after a long day at the beach and pools.

Your whole family with find comfort in the well-appointed bedrooms with sleeping space for up to 6 guests. The master bedroom with king bed enjoys an en suite bath with walk-in shower and dual shower heads. The guest bedroom's seersucker patterned queen bed and built-in bunk punch up the fun in this family suite.

A fully-equipped kitchen services the bar and dining room seating. Pack a picnic to enjoy at the St. Augustine Green on a laid-back afternoon.

Sandy Shell Flat is ready to welcome you!

**This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
